preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address (owner, MarketingWallet, or Developer)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the UpdateTaxes function to set buyTax to a value greater than MaxTax (20). For example, call UpdateTaxes(10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 50, 25, 10, 15) where the 7th parameter (buyTax) is 25, exceeding the MaxTax constant of 20. This demonstrates the owner can bypass the intended fee limit.
